steps.content: The chaotic battle has ended. You managed to keep your emotions under control, so the apparitions didn't cause you much harm. You grab Hecate and try to calm her down.

The team rests briefly far away from the pool, but the contamination from the mine continues to corrode your minds. The <color=#fb9259>water level</color> is still rising, and more and more apparitions appear before your eyes.

steps.speaker: Murky Apparition
steps.content: Those machines are killing people! Where are the Nirvana engineers who came to do the handover? Where are Nirvana's people? Check the code, quick!

steps.speaker: Murky Apparition
steps.content: Self-destruct mode activated? Who did this? Stop them! Stop them now!!

steps.speaker: Murky Apparition
steps.content: Protective mechanism... failed?? Lost contact with Group B27!! D7, D7... turned into a monster!!

steps.speaker: Murky Apparition
steps.content: The M-value readings are off the charts. Something is coming... Something way bigger than a Corruptor... What could it be...

steps.speaker: Murky Apparition
steps.content: Fear not! **** will be here soon! Hold out a bit longer! With his strength, he'll come and solve everything!

steps.speaker: Murky Apparition
steps.content: I'm not leaving! It's the only one that Syndicate has! We have to guard it! As long as we have it, we can...

steps.speaker: Murky Apparition
steps.content: This is our mine! It belongs to Syndicate!
As the anger, fear, grief, despair, and intense paranoia entangling them assaults your mind, you suddenly realize something.
These aren't just Inner Bay heroes brimming with hope. This is also the ground zero of BR-002. Eight years ago, the Corpuscle devoured them and gave birth to the Corpseborne and Black Ring.
This was no coincidence.
You look at the busted mechs half-buried in the ground. Deep in the Mania field, they have long been paralyzed.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: The robots here are all old models. When no one is around to control them, the Mania field will cause them to have all sorts of malfunctions.

Machines aren't humans. The Mania field might cause them to malfunction, but it cannot make them go crazy and kill people. They'd attack humans only if they had been <color=#fb9259>pre-programmed</color> to do so.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: <size=31>In the end, the company agreed to the workers' demands on the condition that they give up all claim to compensation. The two sides completed the handover of the largest mine W-31 on November 25. Inner Bay won for Syndicate its own Hypercube mine.</size>
An organization that built its wealth from monopolizing Hypercubes would never share their pie with workers who were about to be discarded. Not then, not now.
You look at Raven, who looks back at you teasingly. The <color=#fb9259>Executive Officer</color> uniform on her becomes more and more blinding to the eye.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: It might be useful. There are some Nirvana security codes on this Executive Officer uniform. Maybe those cute little robots won't do anything to me.
Looks like some traditions have survived till now.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: ...Are the Executive Committee linked with Nirvana?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: <size=31>BR-004 has been destroyed, and the Ring zone has been brought under control. Soon, there will be a new Hypercube production zone. Nirvana will not let it fall into other hands. They will use the West District Reconstruction Project to <color=#fb9259>return</color> to Syndicate.</size>

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Yes, you've deduced their plan. The Executive Committee is just a puppet organization stacked with Nirvana's people.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: That's why they keep targeting Drifter Camp.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Since Rustfire members were once Nirvana workers, how could Nirvana spare them?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If Nirvana gets ahold of Rustfire's plans, and realizes you still want your own Hypercubes, surely they'd...
She bursts into laughter and starts to applaud.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Chief, you've got what it takes to be a journalist, but think bigger. For instance, Nirvana doesn't need to get ahold of Rustfire's plans at all.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: What a powerful DisCity corporation needs to crush a bunch of downtrodden Syndicans is <color=#fb9259>opportunity</color>, not <color=#fb9259>evidence</color>. All they need to know is that Rustfire has been weakened by the Corpseborne.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: That's more than enough reason for them to totally exterminate us.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Don't worry. Inner Bay's contamination functions as a sturdy barrier. Without meticulous tracking, no one will find us.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Plus, Rustfire's leader is still back at the Drifter Camp. He'll <color=#fb9259>attract all the firepower</color>.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...What do you mean, attract all the firepower?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: I'm not going. I have to stay here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why would he do that?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: For the future of West District, of course.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Inner Bay's BR-002 is the only Black Ring out of DisCity's watchful eye. It's the only mine that Syndicate has a chance of independently controlling. By capturing it, future generations can build up strength to one day escape Nirvana's control.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: This hope used to be slim, but lately, Rustfire's fortunes are turning around.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: The sudden Mania crisis at the Drifter Camp allowed our troops to fake their deaths and relocate to Inner Bay Shelter on a massive scale. Now, Parma is holding up the FAC in Eastside, and the Executive Committee is hunting down Julien.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: And... You came here.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: This is the closest that Rustfire has gotten to our dream in eight years. As long as you destroy BR-002, change will sweep Syndicate. You are everyone's hope.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: So, just focus on completing your mission. Rustfire will assist you at all costs.
She looks up slightly at the broken sky beyond the mine.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Perhaps Julien's already dead by now? If so, he must've died full of hope. He truly believed that you can destroy BR-002.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Though we'll lose our old leader and home, our new victory will inspire the people, who won't grieve for long. They will take the resolve of those who sacrificed themselves and rally around you.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Soon, you'll be Rustfire's sustenance.
